asserts: the governed measurement meaning and response contract are sufficiently identical for the named semantic claim
does_not_assert: measurement portability; equal empirical distributions; equal social role; equal estimand
input_authority: exact measurement identity; source semantics; response-state and routing authority
required_equivalence: exact or explicitly versioned semantic equivalence
preserved_invariants: source meaning; response-state semantics; routing/predicate semantics where claim-relevant
allowed_transform: identity; lossless version bridge explicitly authorized
mandatory_dependencies: local source refs; measurement ancestry; routing/risk-set refs; version authority
falsifiers: meaning drift; response-contract drift; routing drift; unsupported version bridge

asserts: a named local ordering relation corresponds across contexts
does_not_assert: cardinal distance; equal intervals; category identity; same class position
input_authority: local ordinal semantics plus correspondence authority
allowed_transform: strict or weak monotone map as declared
mandatory_dependencies: local order authority; tie policy; risk sets; estimands; map-selection rule
falsifiers: order reversal; tie instability; multiple arbitrary maps yielding same claim

asserts: within-context relative position can be compared under frozen local denominators
does_not_assert: common cardinal scale; global percentile identity; same substantive category
required_equivalence: rank-role correspondence plus compatible target populations
allowed_transform: monotone within-context transform; declared quantile map
mandatory_dependencies: denominator definition; weights/estimand; tie handling; support
falsifiers: denominator sensitivity; rank instability; mapping driven by target result

asserts: a named adjacency/connectivity/opposition relation is preserved without shared coordinates
does_not_assert: metric distance; common axes; node/category identity; social homology
input_authority: local topology construction authority plus node/role correspondence
required_equivalence: partial node/role correspondence sufficient for named topology
preserved_invariants: adjacency; connectivity; component order; branch/opposition as declared
allowed_transform: graph/topology isomorphism or partial correspondence within declared map family
mandatory_dependencies: local topology recipe; thresholds; source topology provenance; representation dependencies
falsifiers: threshold perturbation destroys result; alternative admissible maps fit equally; node semantics fail

asserts: a bounded form or direction of redistribution recurs under mapped conditions
does_not_assert: identical outcome scale; causal mechanism; unconditional recurrence; metric portability
input_authority: local conditional estimands; condition/outcome role correspondence
preserved_invariants: direction; branch redistribution; qualitative shape statistic explicitly frozen
allowed_transform: declared monotone/state aggregation transforms that preserve chosen shape
mandatory_dependencies: local estimands; exposure/risk sets; conditioning support; baseline; scale/link specification
falsifiers: sign/shape changes under lawful representation; support failure; Simpson/reversal under predeclared configurations

asserts: a typed relational pattern among locally constructed roles recurs
does_not_assert: identity of nodes/categories; common field; causal mechanism; homology
input_authority: local motif construction plus typed role correspondence
allowed_transform: role relabeling or partial isomorphism restricted by semantics
mandatory_dependencies: local motif hashes; role authority; map family; negative-control motifs; representation dependencies
falsifiers: motif common under semantic-map permutations; unstable under local perturbation; post-hoc role assignment

asserts: a finite bundle of independently established invariant claims corresponds componentwise
does_not_assert: full measurement equivalence; one latent world-space; causal or theoretical identity
input_authority: all component authorities plus preregistered signature and map authority
allowed_transform: product of component-admissible transforms; partial maps only if preregistered
mandatory_dependencies: component evidence; discriminativeness null; map multiplicity audit; risk sets/estimands; claim ceiling
falsifiers: many arbitrary maps recover signature; one critical component fails; signature chosen after seeing agreement
default_ceiling: strongest composite structural recurrence short of portability

asserts: current authority/evidence does not support a discriminative cross-context correspondence
input_authority: local object provenance and failed/absent transport proof
mandatory_dependencies: recorded candidate maps or authority gaps; falsification receipts
falsifiers: future stronger authority may supersede; current failure itself is not falsified by resemblance
